landing.headline: Building a Better City with Smart Governance
landing.subtitle: Report a civic problem, book an appointment with a department officer, and follow every step until it is closed.

account.footnote: Log out is immediate — no confirmation. Your saved city stays on the device.

home.emptySubtitle: You haven’t submitted any requests yet. Report a problem and you can follow it here until it is closed.

cityPicker.title: Select your city
cityPicker.subtitle: We save this on your device, so you only pick it once.

auth.invalidCredentials: Invalid email or password. Please check and try again.
auth.footnoteSameError: The error never says which field was wrong — the same message covers an unknown email and a bad password.
auth.otpSubtitle: We’ll send a 6-digit code to your registered mobile number.
auth.selectRoleToSignIn: Select your role to sign in.
auth.roleOfficerDesc: Act on requests assigned to you

notifications.emptyBody: Notifications arrive when a complaint is verified or rejected, an officer is assigned, work starts or completes, or an appointment is scheduled.

emergencyContacts.subtitle: Available with or without login. Numbers and their order are maintained by the Municipal Admin.

garbageTracking.noVehicleTitle: No vehicle found for your ward
garbageTracking.noVehicleBody: No garbage vehicle is currently assigned to your ward. If collection has been missed, report it and the Sanitation department will pick it up.

notices.oneWayBroadcast: This is a one-way broadcast from the municipality — there is nothing to acknowledge or subscribe to.

requestDetail.notFound: This request could not be found.
requestDetail.footnote: Read-only. Requests cannot be edited or cancelled after submission — reply through a new complaint if something changed.

appointmentWizard.requestedSubtitle: You’ll be notified once an officer confirms a date and time.
appointmentWizard.availabilityHelp: {{department}} · published weekly hours. You cannot pick a slot — an officer confirms the date and time after reviewing your request.
appointmentWizard.purposePlaceholder: For example: property tax assessment query
appointmentWizard.remarksPlaceholder: Anything the officer should know beforehand.

complaintWizard.discardBody: This complaint has not been submitted yet. If you leave now, the category, description and photos are lost.
complaintWizard.submitFailed: Could not submit your complaint. Nothing was lost — everything below is still here. Try again.
complaintWizard.registeredSubtitle: Your complaint has been sent to the Municipal Admin for verification. You’ll be notified at each step.
complaintWizard.keepForReference: Keep this for reference when you follow up.
complaintWizard.describeHelp: Plain details help the department act faster. {{category}}.
complaintWizard.descriptionPlaceholder: For example: the bin at the corner has not been emptied for four days and is overflowing onto the footpath.
complaintWizard.addPhotosHelp: Optional. You can attach more than one. Total upload limit is 50 MB.
complaintWizard.warnLargeUpload: Over 40 MB attached. Uploads this large may fail on a slow connection.
complaintWizard.blockLimitReached: 50 MB limit reached. Remove a photo before adding another.
complaintWizard.landmarkHelp: Optional landmark. Your ward is already on the request.
complaintWizard.wardNotEditable: From your profile — not editable here
complaintWizard.reviewNote: Nothing is saved until you submit. A complaint cannot be edited or cancelled afterwards.

register.title: Create your account
register.photoPermission: Photo library permission is required to attach a document.
register.duplicateAccount: An account already exists for this mobile number or email.
register.noWards: No wards found for this city yet.
register.alreadyHaveAccount: Already have an account? Log in
register.footnote: On a duplicate-account error every field keeps its value — only the error message clears when you edit the number.

otp.networkError: Could not reach the server. No attempt was used — try again.
otp.usedAllAttempts: You have used all attempts for this code.
otp.noLongerValid: This code is no longer valid.
otp.requestNewOne: Request a new one to continue.
otp.invalidCode: This code is no longer valid. Request a new one.
otp.incorrectCode: Incorrect code. {{count}} attempt{{plural}} left before this code is locked.

myRequests.emptyBodyFilteredComplaints: Nothing of yours is currently {{status}}. Clear the filter to see all your complaints.
myRequests.emptyBodyFilteredAppointments: Nothing of yours is currently {{status}}. Clear the filter to see all your appointments.
myRequests.emptyBodyNoAppointments: You haven’t requested an appointment. Book one with a department officer and it will appear here.
myRequests.emptyBodyNoComplaints: You haven’t submitted a complaint yet.
